description: Eval suite for mcp-server (mcp-doctor D8 / rule C-5: >= 3 cases per registered tool, including a degraded case). Every case is written from the handler named in `source`.

format.cases[].tool: the registered tool name (the field D8 counts)
format.cases[].op: callTool | listTools | harness (from_gate_probe exists only in test/lib/fromGate.ts)
format.cases[].caller: the principal the case assumes: master (BEARER_SECRET_MASTER), seat (an organisation seat token, org acme, non-master), member / org-admin / pre-org-member (Clerk sessions), org-bearer-no-agent, scoped-seat / none (harness fixtures)
format.cases[].runner: offline = decided before any backend call; replayed against the real /mcp route by test/evals-suite.test.ts as master. live = needs a Convex deployment or a non-master principal; shape-checked only, never reported as replayed
format.cases[].expect: isError, textIncludes, protocolErrorIncludes (JSON-RPC error), advertised (tools/list), jsonKeys (keys of the JSON in content[0]), reached (harness)
format.cases[].given: precondition a live case assumes about stored data
